newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS, SOUTH AFRICA TO BAT IN ONE-DAYER.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS, SOUTH AFRICA TO BAT IN ONE-DAYER.

text.p: Ian Healy won the toss and asked South Africa to bat in the
third one day international between the sides on Wednesday.
South Africa - Herschelle Gibbs, Louis Koen, Jacques Kallis,
Daryll Cullinan, Jonty Rhodes, Hansie Cronje (captain), Derek
Crookes, Shaun Pollock, Dave Richardson, Rudi Bryson, Allan
Australia - Michael Di Venuto, Mark Waugh, Stuart Law, Steve
Waugh, Greg Blewett, Michael Bevan, Ian Healy (captain), Shane
Warne, Paul Reiffel, Adam Dale, Jason Gillespie.
